errors.what: clan patch-data with /tmp/h1patch7.json file path failed: invalid JSON patch at column 195 — likely shell encoding of em-dash in file path argument
errors.recovered_by: switched to inline JSON string argument (clan accepts inline JSON starting with '{')

problems_and_friction: The /tmp file-path approach for patch-data failed with an 'invalid escape' error at column 195 despite the file containing valid JSON; this was caused by the bash shell tool writing the em-dash character as a raw UTF-8 byte sequence that clan's parser rejected when reading the file. Switching to inline JSON (passing the JSON string directly as a CLI argument, which clan supports) resolved the issue immediately. No other friction.
context_understood: Flip the verdict field to 'Zoho CRM' and set verdict_rationale to the verbatim text from the supplied rationale file, then validate and snapshot as hop-07.
